title: Getting Into Positions

edits.reason: Intro bullet lists the Positions-tab fields 'entry price, mark price, liquidation price, unrealized P&L, margin used'. Entry (85) and Stop (80) are drawn, but Mark Price is named and not drawn. The chart's whole point is unrealized P&L building as price rises, and unrealized = mark - entry. Placing the gold Mark Price reference at 120 (the final-bar price, inside band ~[83,123]) makes the +35 callout read as Mark(120) - Entry(85) = 35, so the entry-vs-mark calculation becomes locatable. Gold per palette (target/reference magnet).

Lesson bullet explicitly teaches 'Mark price: the reference price used by the exchange to calculate unrealized P&L and liquidation; different from last traded price'. It is the headline mechanism of the unrealized-vs-realized lesson yet is not drawn. yAxis 122 = the final leg's target (last bar), inside band ~[80,125]; the dashed line + right-edge pill anchors unrealized P&L = Mark(122) - Entry(82). Gold per palette. Liquidation price (also taught) is intentionally NOT added: it sits below the Stop Loss (<77), off the visible band, so it would clip — closing that gap needs a candle/SL rework, out of scope for an annotation-only fix.

notes: introChart and lessonChart each draw Entry/Stop (and lesson also TP) but omit Mark Price, which both the intro and lesson text name as a core Positions-tab field and the reference for unrealized P&L. Added a gold Mark Price markLine to each at the final-bar price so the 'mark - entry = unrealized P&L' calculation is visible. Auditor's two Mark Price proposals are accepted as-is (coordinates and color verified inside band). Auditor's liquidation-price 'special/not drawable' note is correct restraint and is recorded but produces no edit. quiz.chart correctly shows only the Entry line pre-cut (cutIndex:10) and routes the +$850 unrealized and 'still open' outcome to revealMarkPoints, so it does not spoil the decision and needs nothing. Margin (taught) is collateral, not a price level, so it is not chart-drawable.
